name: wforge
description: Budget-aware build orchestration for a solo developer: right model per step, capped fan-out, a usage guard for the 5-hour and weekly windows, a crew backlog that measures what each task cost, overnight loops on the API lane, voice input through Handy, and a live terminal board of every subagent with its model, tokens and cost.

soft_threshold.title: Soft threshold (5-hour window %)
soft_threshold.description: Above this percentage wforge downshifts subagents to cheaper models and lower effort.

hard_threshold.title: Hard threshold (5-hour window %)
hard_threshold.description: Above this percentage wforge blocks fan-out: workflows and any subagent that is not on Haiku.

weekly_hard.title: Weekly hard threshold (%)
weekly_hard.description: Above this percentage of the 7-day window wforge blocks fan-out regardless of the 5-hour window.

max_agents.title: Max subagents per 10 minutes
max_agents.description: Subagent launches allowed in any rolling 10-minute window. The 11th and later are refused.
